Introduction

Shin Haram, known under her stage name Rami, is a South Korean singer, rapper and dancer under YG Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group BABYMONSTER with whom she debuted on November 27, 2023 with the group's digital single "Batter Up".

On May 9, 2025, YG announced Rami would temporarily be on hiatus due to health issues, missing the group's next comeback, Hot Sauce.
